scientific_integrity: Analytic indicator-moment proof, fully exhaustive finite bidegree census and exact witness polynomial checks supplied; no claim of external validation or empirical prediction.
scientific_limitations: One-step binary all-neighbors-lost coextinction model; precisely three plants for universal law; no isolated pollinators; common exchangeable primary-loss law. Sharp minimum is for connected networks with identical sizes and bidegree multisets under iid losses; finite census covers total species at most six only. No standardized skewness or ecological data inference. Potential specialized prior coverage remains.
title: Third-moment reversals first appear at seven species in degree-matched coextinction networks
